learning_outcomes.text: Actively use sign language and convey their work to internal and external groups in the field.
Develop their information and communication knowledge and skills using sign language.
Apply the knowledge and abilities gained in their field using sign language in interdisciplinary studies.

syllabus_topics:
Definition of Turkish Sign Language (T
M)
Hand and finger shapes, hand position relative to the body, function of facial expressions
Single and double hand use, relationship of signs to Turkish
Using sign language and spoken language together, not exaggerating lip movements

M
